stem.en: A box holds three pairs of beads. One bead is taken from each pair. How many different sets are possible?

text.en: Three, one set for each pair

feedback.en: Three counts the pairs. Each pair also offers a choice of two.

text.en: Eight, as each pair doubles the count
Six, one set for each bead

feedback.en: Six counts the beads. A set uses three beads, one from each pair.

text.en: Twenty-seven, as the three choices repeat

feedback.en: Each pair gives two choices, not three.

explanation.en: One pair gives 2 sets, two pairs give 4, and three pairs give 8. Each new pair doubles the count.

hints.en: Start with one pair, then add a second.
How many choices does one pair give?
